title: 吊杀的特定卡牌倍率与封顶能力

scope.execution: headless only; no installation, release or remote actions

semantics: Immutable attack metadata carries the target power multiplier, applied after additive Strength; no multiplier for other cards, pet or monster attacks.

Attack finishes before reading current target power and growing it by max(2,current). Only Artifact can observe an incoming request in this admitted domain, so commit clamping preserves native request clamping, including Artifact consuming a capped zero-offset stack.
Existing reversible power metadata, history import, evaluation keys and continuations are reused.
